calls.statement:
SELECT s.format, COUNT(DISTINCT s.store_id) AS stores,
       COUNT(*) AS line_rows,
       COUNT(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS distinct_lines,
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS distinct_sl,
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts,
       SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_before_returns,
       MIN(f.sale_date) AS mind, MAX(f.sale_date) AS maxd,
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.etl_loaded_at) AS loads
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 14 AND 17
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT f.receipt_id, f.sale_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount, f.staff_purchase_flag
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30'
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id) FROM base WHERE NOT staff_purchase_flag) AS rc_distinct,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT receipt_id, store_id, sale_date FROM base WHERE NOT staff_purchase_flag)) AS rc_store_date,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id) FROM base) AS rc_all,
  (SELECT SUM(net_amount) FROM base) AS net_all_incl_staff,
  (SELECT SUM(net_sales_before_returns) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND store_id < 900) AS ctrl_net_before,
  (SELECT SUM(receipts) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND store_id < 900) AS ctrl_receipts,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store GROUP BY store_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT format)>1)) AS stores_multi_format,
  (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT format, ',') FROM dim_store) AS formats;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS receipts_mixed_flag
FROM (
  SELECT f.receipt_id
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30'
  GROUP BY f.receipt_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT f.staff_purchase_flag) > 1
);

SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period, s.format,
       ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) AS atv
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d    ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id < 900
  AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 4
GROUP BY s.format
ORDER BY CASE s.format WHEN 'Large' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END;
